Dear Jack,
   Its me, Skitter. I'm writin you from on top of a dinosaur that used t be our cat Grimlock. Member when i told ya about her? She's just as sweet now. Unless it's Castor, she doesn't seem to like him much. Did you ever meet Wren? I think she's me girlfriend now. She's the one wif the cute red hair and green eyes? She's so smart and brave and pretty. She likes me for who I is and always makes me feel special. Squeak likes her too! As fer the rest of rooftop I hasnt seen em as much trapped on t boat but I did some trainin and have gotten real good wif me fightin. Real fast like. Been workin on me acts more, I think im gettin pretty good. I've also been workin on me acts as it were. Hopin to maybe make money in the new world playin me panflute and acting. Wren also wants me to help her in her foraging shop. I'm  tryin not t steal no more n play it straight, not lyin n the like. Anyways, I miss you n I hope you're findin the best o treasures. Write me back at the included address if ya want. 
Kind regards, Skit. 

(This isn't sent yet, just written, to be sent when able)

Dear Abi,

    I know we didn’t have much time to talk or spend time with one another after our night together as I was destined for Roanoke and the ship left about 2 hours from when we consummated our relationship, But! I wanted to inform you that I had a wonderful night with you those 3 long months ago… The voyage has been a rough one that I cannot deny… I have lost friends, Lovers, and enemies all the same. I can guess that you are likely confused as to why I am writing to you right now… I want to get to know you better honestly, you seemed to be such a commanding presence and a sweet woman as well, I also realized about 2 weeks into my 3 month long journey that there is a strong possibility that you are with child, I just want you to know that I will attempt not to be an absentee father if it is mine…

Thank you, 

    Castor Pierce  AKA The guy you slept with in the bushes outside the police tower in London
(This note is meant to be sent ASAP)

Dear Aris,
> Greetings.
> 
> My name is Viorica Bewick. I am your sister, apparently, ~~hopefully~~. Truth be told, Aris, I do not remember you. This might not be a surprise to you, if you know me as well as I can assume. I do not remember a great many things. I got your name from the contract I signed before leaving. My memory may be faulty, but the words I wrote are concrete. Is Aris short for something?
> 
> Some of my fellow travelers tried to tell me of you, from what little they know. I must not have spoken of you often. Were you a secret I had to keep? Were we close, were we distant? All I can be sure of is that we are family, and that I knew you once. Do we have any other family? I seem to have forgotten them too.
> 
> I have left Bywater ~~if not already obvious~~ and I am writing this from the New World, an ocean away. I am not sure if you already knew of this, not sure if I told you. I do not even know if we managed a goodbye. I remember only leaving Bywater for London, and now months later I am here writing this to you. 
> 
> Write me back, if you can? I would like to know you, and maybe the family that I have forgotten. Is the shop okay? Business going on without me? Sorry for the many questions.
> 
> I would say that I miss you, but I do not want to lie. I __wish__ I could miss you. But we cannot miss what we do not remember. 
> 
> I will try to miss you. I will try to remember. 
Sincerely,
Vee.

(sent whenever possible, but not much a rush)

Nana,
I’ve arrived in the New World. I’ve made so many friends. I’ve even... met someone. I never thought I could be happy like this. I hope you and Papa are doing well. Give my love to Mom, and Aunt Aislin, Aunt Rushnuts, Aunt Tyleen, and Aunt Ordea. I’m working hard to fulfill my oath. I spoke to Dad, the evening before my birthday. He seems well, fulfilling his oath in the Crystalline Spire. 
You’ll be glad to know I’ve embraced my Infernal roots more. I was cursed to be a fiend, horns and tail included. But I kind of like it. 
Please let me know if anything changes with Mom. I’m still trying to find a cure. 
I love you all.
Your Wynnie

Dear Jack, 
I aint heard from you but it turns out time is slowed down here or sometin. There's a lot of tribes here. Seems our group has upset almost all of them. The island is floodin. Me n me new mates Seline n Lucky helped save some of one tribe (jackalopes they are called). But evil tings keep attackin seems like its gettin worse. Fires last week. Floods this week. Loads of dangers all over t island. People are gettin killed, one at least has been brought back. It's scary. I been helpin take care o the other kids without parents as well as me new guests. Helpin take care o Fabertells business. Makin honey potions that help people heal n do cool stuff. Learned t embroider spells too! I can do magic now, mostly just healin but also I can talk t animals whenever I want. Been talkin to me bees a lot. Theyre good listeners. Just so much happenin. Wren is head archivist now. She's real busy. Big job. Web and Baeshra got married! It's easy to lose the good here but im trying to remember the good stuff. Hope all is well with you! Find any cool treasures?! Don't ever come visit. 
Miss you, Skitter.
